title: A Protocol for the Horizon
author: Tamsin Underhill
blurb: Odile Montrose, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
